messages:
alexa: Heads up — canary for zephyrus14b-int4 started, seeing sporadic OOM spikes after ~1500 sustained requests. setup: batch=3, streaming=true, max_new_tokens=1200, quant=per-channel int4.
alexa: quick reproduce: `POST /v1/generate {model: zephyrus14b-int4, prompt: <long>, max_new_tokens:1200, stream:true, batch_size:3}`
raj: paste the allocator trace when you have it pls.
alexa: clipped trace: 
```
W gpu-alloc: attempted cudaMalloc 134217728 failed
node-7: rss=21.9GiB, free_frag_total=980MiB, largest_free=96MiB
KV cache delta: +8% per 1k tokens when streaming enabled
```
morgan: Two things jump out: streaming + large max_new_tokens increases temporary KV/window buffers; int4 per-channel kernel tiling can create ephemeral temp buffers that fragment. my suggestions: 1) try stream buffer cap (stream_max_prefetch=256 tokens) 2) reduce canary default max_new_tokens to 512 3) enable slot_compactor aggressive mode for canary, 4) try lowering batch to 2 for a short window.
morgan: minimal canary config to test: 
```yaml
model: zephyrus14b-int4
canary: true
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 512
  batch_size: 3
  streaming: true
  stream_max_prefetch: 256
  soft_reserve: 0.07
  slot_compactor_mode: aggressive
  kv_trim_on_idle: true
```
serena: we should also capture a per-kernel allocation timeline (start->end) to see which kernels leak or cause fragmentation. raj, can infra enable heap snapshots every 5 minutes for the canary hosts?
raj: yep, will enable nvtx and allocator snapshots; also add an endpoint to fetch last N snapshot diffs. expect slight CPU overhead.
serena: rollout idea: phase 1 reduce max_new_tokens to 512 at 5% traffic; phase 2 enable stream_max_prefetch cap and slot_compactor at 10% traffic; phase 3 if still noisy, try final-layer per-tensor quant (small quality delta) at 5% with eval. run regression eval set: `zeph-reg-2026-03-v2` (600 prompts, mix long/short).
alexa: baseline before changes on a dev canary: p50=110ms, p95=480ms, tokens/s=175. OOMs started after continuous streaming bursts >30s.
morgan: fallback policy: if OOM_count > 2 in 15m on a host, route that host's traffic to zephyrus13b-int4 and mark host for immediate compaction and a restart. also consider auto-clamping max_new_tokens to 256 for streaming sessions if memory pressure high.
raj: infra-bot scheduled: canary deploy A/B at 2026-03-24T02:00Z. snapshots enabled. logs will stream to #eng-ml-telemetry.
alexa: deploying variant A (max_new_tokens=512 + compactor) now to 5% — will post first telemetry in ~30m. tagging @morgan @raj @serena. thanks! :rocket:
